angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 657,437 km at 140.93 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.0955 +/- 0.0199 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 140.93 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.945 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Sozzetti et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-370 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract): 657,437 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.962 +/- 0.035 solar masses from Sozzetti et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-370 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5662 +/- 44 K from Sozzetti et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-370 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Sozzetti et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-370 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-370.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.470, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-370 (pscomppars): spectral type G5 V, from Sozzetti et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-370 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Sozzetti et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-370 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.12703, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-370 (pscomppars): age 1.4 Gyr, from Sozzetti et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-370 (pscomppars): rotation period 13.55 d, from Sozzetti et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-370 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.3 km/s, from Sozzetti et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535..531S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.945 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.935. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
